body:
B0-C TIMESTAMP/MAPPING EXPECTED-DATA ORACLE V1 — exact review proposal. Documentation/data specification only; no code, source read, media, dependency, runtime, provider, generator or implementation authority.

This is the missing bounded artifact between accepted F0 V3 and C1-T. It freezes the two-acquisition-run repair semantics and the provider-free input/expected-output cases that C1-B/C/D must later pass. It does not execute the oracle and does not let C1 author its own authority.

## 1. Artifact and identity

One versioned canonical artifact:

TimestampMappingExpectedDataV1
- header;
- local axis and relation fixtures;
- ordered cases;
- ordered typed expected outcomes;
- identity equality/change/refusal assertions.

Stable identity:

ExpectedDataId = H(
  namespace and schema version,
  canonical-encoding version,
  ordered case inputs,
  ordered typed expected outcomes,
  identity equality/change/refusal assertions,
  declared arithmetic bounds and rounding policies,
  digest primitive and version
)

Two independent documentation receipts remain separate:

DerivationReceiptId = H(
  ExpectedDataId,
  normative equations and hand-calculation method,
  calculation transcript or worksheet digest
)

ReviewReceiptId = H(
  ExpectedDataId,
  DerivationReceiptId,
  independent reviewer identity,
  independently recomputed fields,
  disposition
)

B0-C acceptance binds all three, but ExpectedDataId is the stable scientific coordinate.

A later separately authorized F0 realization may add:

OracleRealizationId = H(
  ExpectedDataId,
  independent implementation source digest,
  runtime/toolchain/dependency closure,
  realized output digest,
  cache identity
)

Implementation source, runtime closure and cache identity are intentionally absent from B0-C. C1 cannot provide OracleRealizationId because C1 is the system under test. C1 produces only a conformance receipt against ExpectedDataId.

## 2. Case schema

Every ordered case contains:

- caseId;
- owner: C1B | C1C | C1D;
- class: Control | SyntheticAdapterMutation;
- controlCaseId for each mutation;
- tagged input: TimestampEnvelope | RelationConstruction | ProjectionQuery | UnresolvedManifestResolution;
- typed expected outcome;
- identity assertions: Same | Different | Refuse;
- for mutations: base digest, exactly one changed field, mutated digest and detecting court.

Timestamp inputs bind PTS and DTS independently; original raw fields; field and operation provenance; exact timebase; origin; epoch; occurrence; rendition; duration; and requested representation.

Mapping inputs bind family; directed source/target axes and roles; normalized exact segments; gaps; holds; occurrences; explicit epoch/discontinuity seams; endpoint semantics; tolerance; and a separate derivation receipt.

Projection requests bind direction; point or half-open interval; target lattice; rounding/enclosure policy; and representable bounds.

Expected projection outcomes are exactly:
Exact | Quantized | Enclosing | Gap | OutsideDomain | NoCorrespondence | Ambiguous | Refused.

Missingness, Option and generic error strings cannot stand in for these outcomes.

## 3. Normative two-acquisition-run repair

Two acquisition runs remain two axes and epochs. Raw run-local seconds never concatenate or compare directly.

Synthetic control:
- run A local [0,5) maps exactly to edition [0,5);
- run B resets to local [0,5) but maps exactly to edition [7,12);
- edition [5,7) is an explicit no-sample/gap interval with a declared seam;
- equal local tick 1 in A and B denotes distinct coordinates and maps to edition 1 and 8;
- reverse projection returns the correct run-scoped preimage;
- composition cannot bridge [5,7);
- changing run order, run identity, gap, anchor, epoch or seam changes relation/support identity or refuses;
- absent required anchor evidence yields a typed unestablished/refused repair, never guessed continuity.

This is not the F0 two-clean-build determinism court. It is a mathematical two-acquisition-run ClockRepair fixture. D0 remains the first source-specific reader and later emits the realized repair receipt.

## 4. Exact case roster

C1-B timestamp envelope:

B01 presence matrix — all four PTS/DTS present/missing combinations remain independent; packet sentinel cannot construct a coordinate.

B02 provenance collision — packet-field INT64_MIN -> missing. Rescale overflow returning the same raw value -> Refused(Arithmetic). Nearby control 4611686018427387903 × 2 is representable; mutation 4611686018427387904 × 2 is not.

B03 PASS_MINMAX — a packet sentinel carried through PASS_MINMAX remains missing; control -1 remains a lawful present tick. Erasing provenance and constructing Present(INT64_MIN) fails.

B04 packet order — PTS=5,DTS=5 accepts; PTS=4,DTS=5 refuses while retaining originals/provenance. Swap, clamp, relabel, reorder and discard mutations fail.

B05 duration trichotomy — +1 -> known positive; 0 -> unknown; -1 -> refusal. Zero-to-empty, zero-to-instant and zero-to-measured-zero mutations fail.

B06 signed control — negative PTS/DTS with nonzero negative origin remain lawful and exact. DTS-only input cannot construct presentation evidence.

C1-C shared projection and ClockRepair:

C01 exact rational — 1/4 second -> 250 ms is Exact; 2/8 normalizes identically.

C02 quantization — 1/3 second -> 1000/3 ms under declared floor yields Quantized(333,residual=1/3), never Exact(333). Distinct rationals rounding to 333 retain distinct residuals.

C03 signed/enclosing rounding — -1/3 second under floor yields -334 with residual 2/3. [1/3,2/3) seconds under declared outward enclosure yields tagged [333,667) ms, never exact coverage.

C04 overflow — an independent arbitrary-precision result outside requested signed bounds yields Refused. Relabelling it Missing, Gap, OutsideDomain, NoCorrespondence or Ambiguous fails.

C05 relation versus receipt — [0,10) -> [100,120) and a collinear split at 4 have the same canonical relation when no seam intervenes; their derivation receipts differ.

C06 identity mutations — independently change family, direction, intercept, endpoint, occurrence or explicit seam: relation identity changes or construction refuses.

C07 epoch collision — equal raw tick 7 in different epochs/occurrences remains distinct. Equal-coefficient segments separated by an epoch/discontinuity seam cannot coalesce; deleting the seam changes identity/support or refuses.

C08 composition/tolerance — exact bijective round-trip succeeds; composition preserves an explicit intermediate gap; endpoint-only gap bridging fails. Values merely within fitted tolerance remain unequal.

C09 two-run reset/gap — the normative A/B fixture above preserves run identity, reset, seam, edition gap and set-correct reverse; guessed concatenation and gap deletion fail.

C1-D TrackComposition, correspondence and finalization:

D01 composition gap — mapped sections surrounding target [4,6) produce Gap inside; bridging from mapped endpoints fails.

D02 hold — a source instant held over target [5,8) reverses to a typed hold/preimage witness, never an arbitrary exact first match.

D03 repeat/reorder — repeated source material has distinct occurrence IDs and reverse returns every scoped preimage. Dropping occurrence or selecting first match fails; reordered ranges remain lawful.

D04 EditionCorrespondence — in-domain absence yields NoCorrespondence; outside relation domain yields OutsideDomain; many-to-many/nonmonotone correspondence returns a set or Ambiguous, never a coordinate cast.

D05 bundle finalization — an unresolved local mapping reference refuses checked SourceBundle. Once every canonical relation validates, finalization succeeds. Changing relation, direction, family, gap, hold, occurrence, epoch, seam, endpoint, rendition or checksum changes bundle/edition identity or refuses.

Every mutation has a nearby valid control. The roster covers the accepted F0 V3 synthetic timestamp/mapping mutations: sentinel, rescale collision, PASS_MINMAX, PTS/DTS order, unknown duration, negative origin, epoch collision, quantization/refusal, set-valued reverse, occurrence loss and gap bridging.

## 5. Independent arithmetic boundary

B0-C expected values use normalized rational equations and arbitrary-precision hand calculation or worksheet arithmetic with explicit signed rounding and exact residuals. The independent reviewer recomputes every numeric field and identity Same/Different/Refuse assertion without using future C1 timestamp, rational, mapping, projection, canonicalization or fingerprint code.

Only the canonical schema and declared digest primitive may later be shared with an executable realization.

## 6. Claim ceiling and dependency

B0-C V1 may establish only exact, independently reviewed mathematical expectations and immutable expected-data identity. It does not establish executable replay, runtime independence, toolchain reproducibility, source-specific clock repair, media validity, reader behavior, provider behavior, coverage, boundaries, or narrative quality.

Execution partitions by owner without changing ExpectedDataId: B rows test C1-B, C rows test C1-C, D rows test C1-D. Aggregate C1 cannot close until every row passes on JVM, JS and Native. Later F0 realization may independently execute the same ExpectedDataId. It may not rewrite it.

Reviewers: ACCEPT / AMEND / BLOCK this exact finite V1 under the anti-dither rule. If accepted, promote it as B0-C with a canonical expected-data file plus derivation worksheet and independent review receipt; no code or runtime.
